title: Earmark: change a lead's limit
description: Sets how much a lead pays at once without approval. Lowering applies at once. Raising waits 1 day, and any approver can cancel it.

fields.name: budget_id
fields.label: Budget number
fields.help: Shown in the budget's address on Earmark: /budgets/0 is budget 0.

fields.name: amount
fields.label: New limit
fields.help: In USDC's smallest unit: 1 USDC = 1000000, 0.25 USDC = 250000.

summary: Earmark budget {{budget_id}}: {{lead}} pays at once up to {{amount}} (USDC base units)
